The dish looks like a small white bowl holding sliced almonds. The bowl is about 190 px across in the image. Using the guideline that a bowl is about 15 cm, that gives roughly 12-15 cm, so the bowl is probably small.

The bowl looks fairly full of flaked almonds, though they are lightly packed. A bowl of this size holds about 300 mL. Sliced almonds have a bulk density of roughly 0.35 g/mL, so a full bowl would be about 100 g. The bowl looks about 60-70% full, which gives roughly 50-60 g. I'll take 55 g.

Almonds are about 580 kcal per 100 g, so 55 g is about 320 kcal.
